one_line: Shaiva Maitraka ruler of Vallabhi whose prosperous western Indian court patronised multiple learned traditions, c. 595–615 CE.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, sturdy build with a calm, authoritative bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown western Indian complexion, sharp straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, faint beard shadow, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes, and a composed, dignified default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted slightly off-centre, drawn back into a short, tidy knot at the back of the head; front kept smooth with no loose fringe, crowned by a simple gold circlet set with a small central dark-red cabochon gem, and a narrow saffron cloth band tied under it, the ends tucked neatly behind the knot.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length cream-coloured cotton tunic (angarkha-style) with a right-side overlap and three-quarter sleeves, subtle woven borders in muted maroon at the cuffs and hem, over slim off-white churidar-style trousers; around his shoulders and upper torso is draped a rich saffron-orange silk uttariya, coming from his left shoulder across the chest and looping under the right arm with a second fold over the left forearm, its edges lined with a fine gold thread border; at the waist sits a broad deep-maroon cloth belt reinforced with leather inside, from which hangs a small flat pouch; simple gold kadas (bracelets) at both wrists, a single short gold chain with a modest circular pendant bearing an engraved trident-like Shaiva motif, and small round gold ear studs, all rendered without excess ornament to keep him practical and kingly rather than ostentatious; sandals are brown leather with a toe loop and a strap over the instep, era-appropriate and sturdy.
appearance.signature: A straight, single-edged Indian sword with a slightly broad blade and a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark leather, sheathed in a plain brown scabbard with two discreet gold fittings, worn at his left side and held in his right hand in a relaxed but ready grip.

ref_desc: Siladitya I Dharmaditya is a dignified, medium-built Shaiva king with neat black hair knot, gold circlet, cream tunic, off-white trousers, saffron-orange silk uttariya, maroon belt, simple gold ornaments, brown sandals, and a plain leather-hilt sword in brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Siladitya I Dharmaditya: a dignified early-40s Shaiva Maitraka ruler from Vallabhi with medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp nose, neat black hair pulled into a short knot, small moustache, calm almond eyes, and a composed expression; he wears a simple gold circlet with a central dark-red gem and a narrow saffron band beneath it, a knee-length cream cotton angarkha-style tunic with right-side overlap and muted maroon borders at sleeves and hem, slim off-white churidar trousers, and a rich saffron-orange silk uttariya draped from left shoulder across chest and under right arm, with a second fold resting over his left forearm edged in fine gold thread; a broad deep-maroon waist belt with a small pouch, plain gold bracelets, short gold chain with subtle Shaiva emblem pendant, and small round gold ear studs complete his kingly yet restrained look; brown leather sandals with toe loop and instep strap fit the era; at his left side hangs a straight single-edged sword in a plain brown scabbard with discreet gold fittings, the iron hilt wrapped in dark leather, which he holds lightly in his right hand; show him in neutral front, side, and three-quarter views, clearly presenting face, hairstyle, circlet, draped garments, belt, footwear, and sword in consistent saffron orange, cream, maroon, gold, and brown colours.
